bio: Barnham Broom is home to numerous facilities including a 4-star hotel in beautiful surroundings, two 18-hole golf courses, luxury spa, health & fitness club and Brasserie restaurant serving dinner and Afternoon Tea.  The Brasserie Lounge is a stylish space with relaxing interiors and lovely views across the golf course. It’s the perfect place to catch up with friends while enjoying the beautiful surroundings and warmth of our log fire on cooler days.  Their delicious Afternoon Tea is served with a selection of dainty finger sandwiches, a range of delightful cakes, freshly baked scones and a range of fine loose-leaf teas. Guests are also offered the opportunity to upgrade their afternoon tea to an indulgent Chocolate Lovers’ Afternoon Tea, or to include a glass of champagne or cocktail of your choice. During the Christmas season, a festive option is also available.
